label: Pizza Hut Delivery UK — Allergens & Nutrition booklet (valid from July 2026)
basis: per whole product (serves count recorded in serving_desc)
notes: SOLVED. Found via Contentful, not via the ordering API. How: the SPA bundle main.*.js exposes contentfulCms.deliveryApiKey (RPf5VzSzPkQcidaDhZVqur2FGDY7Mlc3hhxK-YTgGIg) and space gsh8f6v1sw3c; listing https://cdn.contentful.com/spaces/gsh8f6v1sw3c/environments/master/assets returns 1968 assets of which 31 are PDFs, and exactly one is the current nutrition booklet titled 'Allergens & Nutrition' (DELEX_AIN_Booklet_C3_2026_V1_1.pdf, valid from July 2026). Pages 0-3 are the allergen/ingredient matrix; pages 4-9 are full nutrition tables with Energy(kcal)/Fat/Saturated Fat/Carbohydrate/Sugar/PROTEIN/Salt, per whole product and again per serving. An older 31-page 'Allergen & Nutrition October 2024' PDF is also in the space and parses the same way. GRAPHQL LEAD RESOLVED AS A DEAD END FOR PROTEIN (record this so nobody redoes it): the storefront endpoint https://www.pizzahut.co.uk/ph_uk/storefront/graphql IS fully unlockable without an account - POST https://www.pizzahut.co.uk/v1/oidc/oauth2/token with form body grant_type=guest&client_id=ph_uk_web and header originatingAppId: ph_uk_web returns an access_token; sending it as Authorization: Bearer <tok> turns every UNAUTHORIZED into real data (stores, storeByNumber(...).menuByChannel(channel:WEB), ~790 productVariants per store). But although the schema defines ProductVariant.nutrition -> Nutrition.nutritionalValues -> NutritionalValuePerBasis{protein ...}, that field is null on 792/792 variants; the only populated nutrition data is the string list nutritionInformation: ['calories:2231','serves:3'] - energy and serves only, no protein. Also confirmed dead: /order/pdfs/Nutritional-Information.pdf serves the SPA shell, and the DINE-IN_AIN_Booklet (Pizza Hut Restaurants, a separate company) is allergens/ingredients only. PDF traps handled in the adapter: the Category and Product-name columns are rotated 90 degrees so extract_tables returns them character- and line-reversed (rebuilt from char geometry: sort glyphs by top descending, wrapped lines by x0 ascending); column headers are rotated too so no header ever literally contains 'kcal' or 'protein' and column order must be positional; each page yields both a 'Nutrition Per Whole Product' (11 col) and a 'Nutrition Per Serving' (7 col) table.
